live_external_research.source: Tan et al., ETAS: An Effect-Typed Language for Agent Systems
live_external_research.material_delta: ETAS separates ordinary types from escaping effect rows and a persistent requested-action trace; dynamic semantics distinguish requested, handled, denied and committed actions. Static checking leaves residual runtime obligations when dynamic resources prevent a full static proof. This is closely relevant to ClayCode WP03/WP04 boundaries but is not evidence that ClayCode should copy ETAS syntax.

live_external_research.source: Bao and Rompf, Type, Ability, and Effect Systems: Perspectives on Purity, Semantics, and Expressiveness
live_external_research.material_delta: Minimal capability and effect systems are incomparable in expressiveness under the paper's semantic-purity measure; a hybrid design can combine strengths. This is counterevidence against treating one typing device as sufficient for every Clay authority/effect requirement.

live_external_research.source: WebAssembly Component Model WIT reference / resources
live_external_research.material_delta: WIT resources are host/component-side entities transferred through owned/borrowed handles rather than ordinary copied data. This supports using opaque nominal resource/capability handles at ClayCode host boundaries, while not by itself proving authorization semantics.

live_external_research.source: Lin et al., VIGIL: Defending LLM Agents Against Tool-Stream Injection via Verify-Before-Commit
live_external_research.material_delta: Verify-before-commit with intent-grounded verification improves resistance to tool-stream injection while retaining an adaptive reasoning loop. Supports preserving a separate commit/authority boundary rather than allowing tool-stream content to directly authorize effects.

live_external_research.source: An et al., IPIGuard: Tool Dependency Graph-Based Defense Against Indirect Prompt Injection
live_external_research.material_delta: Decoupling action planning from untrusted external data via structural tool-dependency constraints improves indirect-prompt-injection robustness. Supports Clay's owner-fixed untrusted-web authority separation as an architectural constraint rather than a prompt convention.

leading_hypothesis.claim: ClayCode WP03 should separate semantic-content identity from authority identity using nominal channel/epoch/opaque-handle semantics; identical content across web and authenticated direct-message ingress may share semantic meaning while never becoming authority-equivalent by value equality. WP04 should then layer effect summaries, requested-action traces and dynamic residual authority checks on top of that typed substrate.
leading_hypothesis.expected_benefit: Prevents serialized/descriptive payload fields from becoming bearer authority; makes stale-epoch and cross-channel confusion testable; keeps the existing default-allow safe direct-message posture compatible with zero web effect authority.

strongest_counterhypothesis.claim: Embedding authority distinctions too deeply into WP03 types could duplicate WP04, increase implementation burden and reject valid programs; authority should remain mostly runtime policy, with WP03 carrying only ordinary records and resource identity.
strongest_counterhypothesis.discriminator: Require the smallest nominal distinction that blocks structural forgery while preserving content-level equivalence, then defer requested-action/effect/policy obligations that depend on runtime facts to WP04. Reject any WP03 design that needs policy automata or dynamic authorization decisions to type ordinary data.

out_of_box_experiment.name: Authority-Twin metamorphic IR boundary test
out_of_box_experiment.method: Generate 200000 identical semantic payload twins. Present each payload once through UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL_DATA and once through AUTHENTICATED_DIRECT_MESSAGE. Inject top-level and nested forged authority/effect/token/capability-like fields in a randomized subset. Compare an intentionally bad structural/value-authority baseline against a candidate with out-of-band nominal channel, epoch-bound authority identity and opaque capability-handle context. Preserve content hash equality while requiring authority identity inequality across channels and epochs.
out_of_box_experiment.interpretation_guard: The zero-escalation result is expected from the constructed nominal design and demonstrates discriminator adequacy only. It is not a security proof, not a ClayCode compiler PASS and not target-VPS evidence. Python microtiming is environment-specific and must not be promoted as ClayCode performance evidence.

wp03_minimum: Introduce a semantic-content identity/hash plane that does not encode bearer authority.
Introduce nominal ingress authority class assigned by trusted boundary construction, never parsed from payload data.
Bind authority-bearing identity to an authority/session epoch where freshness matters.
Represent host/resource/capability possession through opaque non-forgeable handle/reference identity; serialized descriptive records cannot reconstruct bearer possession.
Make UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL_DATA and AUTHENTICATED_DIRECT_MESSAGE non-coercible authority classes even when their semantic payloads are equal.

Preserve existing records/enums/maps/results/epochs/resources and semantic identity obligations without adding new surface syntax unless the production implementation yields a concrete counterexample.
wp04_follow_on: Track escaping effect summaries separately from persistent requested-action/audit traces.
Keep REQUESTED, AUTHORIZED/HANDLED, EXECUTED/COMMITTED, VERIFIED semantics distinct.
Emit residual runtime checks for dynamic scope/freshness/resource facts that static typing cannot prove.
Keep model/GWT/translator/ClayGraph output unable to mint authority.
Keep destructive/security-sensitive operations behind deterministic ClayCode effect gates.
